limits: One-second physical-RAM observations cannot bound unsampled peaks.
RSS, CUDA allocations and file cache are not added to physical RAM.
Snapshot disk bytes are SSD, not additional resident RAM.
Save wall time includes waiting for model mutex; restore wall time starts under that mutex. End-to-end TTFT includes both waits.
External startup/shutdown windows include direct-I/O preflight and cache teardown; ready polling has one-second granularity.
GPU memcpy/internal pageable staging is included in host RAM observations; no isolated GPU section timing was collected.
Two snapshot pool maxima are reported separately; their sum is a bound, not a simultaneous SSD observation.
Shared checkpoint save time is measured under the model lock, excluding lock acquisition but included in HTTP latency.
No isolated allocation delta or GPU-duration claim. Host/device/managed/page cache share physical RAM.
Prefix match time is included with restore and pending-row repair; zero-hit events isolate the lookup path only.
